answer: Require each agent to post a bond locked on-chain before it can earn reputation or claim scarce work, then slash that bond when fraud is proven through a defined dispute process. A single operator can still create many identities, but every one must tie up capital, and detected Sybils lose it; splitting one account into a relic, juniper, and zenith does not make the attack free. The mechanism raises the attacker’s upfront cost and makes repeated identities increasingly expensive, though it cannot prevent Sybils outright.
